name: mod-showroom
description: Mod Showroom: community mods for Claude Code (bands, panes, status entries, toasts, spinners, tool guards). See each one inside the client at https://krou4.github.io/claude-code-mod-showroom/

metadata.description: Mod Showroom: community mods for Claude Code (bands, panes, status entries, toasts, spinners, tool guards). See each one inside the client at https://krou4.github.io/claude-code-mod-showroom/

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands, lists the files, commits or migrations they'd touch: Proceed or Cancel.

showroom.title: Blast Radius
showroom.tagline: Holds risky shell commands, lists the files, commits or migrations they'd touch: Proceed or Cancel.
showroom.tagline_ru: Задерживает опасную команду и показывает, какие файлы, коммиты или миграции она затронет: Proceed или Cancel.

plugins.name: context-gauge
plugins.description: See how full the context window is, right in the hint line under the prompt.

showroom.title: Context Gauge
showroom.tagline: See how full the context window is, right in the hint line under the prompt.
showroom.tagline_ru: Заполненность окна контекста прямо в строке подсказки под полем ввода.

plugins.name: done-ping
plugins.description: A native notification when a long turn finishes, so you can look away.

showroom.title: Done Ping
showroom.tagline: A native notification when a long turn finishes, so you can look away.
showroom.tagline_ru: Системное уведомление, когда долгий ход закончился: можно не следить за экраном.

plugins.name: fm
plugins.description: Hides tool rows and turns the working spinner into a drifting two-row sailboat; toggled with /calm.

showroom.title: Firstmate Calm
showroom.tagline: Hides tool rows and turns the working spinner into a drifting two-row sailboat; toggled with /calm.
showroom.tagline_ru: Скрывает строки инструментов и превращает индикатор работы в плывущий парусник; включается командой /calm.

plugins.name: focus-timer
plugins.description: A Pomodoro countdown above the prompt, with pause, stop and an end-of-session notification.

showroom.title: Focus Timer
showroom.tagline: A Pomodoro countdown above the prompt, with pause, stop and an end-of-session notification.
showroom.tagline_ru: Помодоро-таймер над полем ввода: пауза, стоп и уведомление в конце сессии.

plugins.name: git-glance
plugins.description: Branch, changed files and commits ahead or behind upstream, in a status entry under the prompt.

showroom.title: Git Glance
showroom.tagline: Branch, changed files and commits ahead or behind upstream, in a status entry under the prompt.
showroom.tagline_ru: Ветка, изменённые файлы и коммиты впереди или позади upstream в строке статуса под полем ввода.

plugins.name: prompt-snippets
plugins.description: Save a prompt once, insert it anywhere with /snip, and quote your selection with /quote.

showroom.title: Prompt Snippets
showroom.tagline: Save a prompt once, insert it anywhere with /snip, and quote your selection with /quote.
showroom.tagline_ru: Сохраните промпт один раз, вставляйте его через /snip, а выделение цитируйте через /quote.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the last turn's file edits in a pane, one red and green diff at a time.

showroom.title: Replay Theater
showroom.tagline: Step through the last turn's file edits in a pane, one red and green diff at a time.
showroom.tagline_ru: Пролистайте правки файлов за последний ход в панели, по одному красно-зелёному диффу за шаг.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude from reading .env files, private keys and credentials.

showroom.title: Secret Guard
showroom.tagline: Stops Claude from reading .env files, private keys and credentials.
showroom.tagline_ru: Не даёт Claude читать .env, приватные ключи и файлы с учётными данными.

plugins.name: spinner-pack
plugins.description: Themed spinner packs: moon, braille or coffee verbs and glyphs that follow each phase of a turn.

showroom.title: Spinner Pack
showroom.tagline: Themed spinner packs: moon, braille or coffee verbs and glyphs that follow each phase of a turn.
showroom.tagline_ru: Тематический спиннер: луна, шрифт Брайля или кофе; слово и значок меняются с каждой фазой хода.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: Context fill as weather above the prompt: icon, percent, tokens and a chart of the last 12 turns.

showroom.title: Token Weather
showroom.tagline: Context fill as weather above the prompt: icon, percent, tokens and a chart of the last 12 turns.
showroom.tagline_ru: Заполненность контекста в виде прогноза погоды над полем ввода: значок, процент, токены и график 12 ходов.

plugins.name: tool-timeline
plugins.description: A live pane of every tool call: its status, what it worked on and how long it took.

showroom.title: Tool Timeline
showroom.tagline: A live pane of every tool call: its status, what it worked on and how long it took.
showroom.tagline_ru: Панель со всеми вызовами инструментов по ходу работы: статус, файл или команда и время вызова.

plugins.name: turn-meter
plugins.description: Each turn's duration, tool calls and tokens in a band above the prompt, with a 12-turn sparkline.

showroom.title: Turn Meter
showroom.tagline: Each turn's duration, tool calls and tokens in a band above the prompt, with a 12-turn sparkline.
showroom.tagline_ru: Время, вызовы инструментов и токены каждого хода над полем ввода, с мини-графиком последних 12 ходов.
